tests: a click on the greyed-out Undo or Redo button, before any file has been opened, prints an IDE internal error
steps:
1. Start the IDE and open any project, or cancel the New / Open Project dialog. Open no file.
2. Click the greyed-out Undo or Redo button on the toolbar.
3. The DEBUG CONSOLE prints a red line: IDE internal error: Uncaught TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'defaultContext'), and it prints another for each further click.
